description: shapes module: closed, outward-wound triangle-soup generators — box_surface(min,max), sphere_surface(centre,r,n_lat,n_lon) (pebble/particle), cylinder_surface(base,r,h,n_seg) (fuel pin) — plus surface_volume(points,tris) via the divergence formula. Lets carve/carve_region mesh reactor geometry (coolant around a pebble = domain box minus sphere) with no blender dependency. Pure Rust. V&V: box vol exact; sphere/cylinder enclosed volume within a few % of analytic (UV discretisation); carve_region(box minus sphere) ~ box_vol - sphere_vol.
title: cfmesh: triangle-soup shape generators (box/sphere/cylinder) for reactor test geometry

description: carve_region currently lumps all boundary faces into one 'walls' patch. Separate them by which surface a face borders: outer/domain boundary -> 'walls', each hole -> 'hole_N'. Needed to apply distinct BCs (vessel wall vs fuel/pebble surface vs coolant in/out). Generalize assemble_kept to bucket boundary faces into named patches via a patch_of(neighbour) classifier; carve_region tags each non-kept cell with its containing hole. V&V: shell box-minus-box -> 2 patches ('walls'+'hole_0') with sensible face counts, faces sum to total boundary; carve_box unchanged (single 'walls' patch); foam bridge maps each patch to a PatchKind.
title: cfmesh: per-surface boundary patch separation

description:
MAINTAINER-CAUGHT DEFECT, 2026-08-12. Logged because the failure mode matters more than the instance.

WHAT WAS REPORTED (by agents, all measured and true): TampinesSteamArray::set_inlet_enthalpy has no effect; FvMatrix::solve returns a field with zero-gradient boundaries, and step() re-stamps the BC template for u and p but not for he. Fix briefed as 'restamp the he BC after each solve'.

WHAT WAS ACTUALLY WRONG (maintainer): the energy equation had ZERO-GRADIENT BOUNDARIES ON BOTH SIDES, which is a basic CFD error. Restamping restores the value while leaving the formulation wrong.

- A zero-gradient inlet gives h_face = h_cell0, so advective influx is mdot*h_cell0 -- the domain advects in ITS OWN enthalpy. Self-referential; the interior is structurally indifferent to what flows in.
- Zero-gradient at both ends means no boundary through which energy can enter or leave, so mdot*(h_out - h_in) = Q cannot be posed.
- CORRECT: fixedValue (Dirichlet) at the inlet; inletOutlet at the outlet -- mixed, keyed on face-flux sign, degenerating to zeroGradient on outflow and clamping to inletValue on inflow.

WHY PLAIN ZEROGRADIENT AT THE OUTLET IS NOT ENOUGH HERE: it is only safe while flow never reverses, and this workspace reverses routinely. Edwards blowdown flashes and reverses; natural circulation reverses at start-up and stagnation; a counter-flow exchanger has its two outlets at opposite ends.

SCOPE OF THE AUDIT THIS IMPLIES -- do not assume it is limited to the enthalpy equation or to these two arrays:
1. Every field solved on these arrays (u, p, he, and any scalar added later): name each boundary condition and justify it physically. 'Whatever FvMatrix::solve defaulted to' is not a boundary condition.
2. Both TampinesSteamArray and OPCPFluidArray, since they are sibling ports and both were affected.
3. tuas_boussinesq_solver's FluidArray and SolidColumn, which share the lineage and have not been checked.
4. Any other consumer of FvMatrix::solve -- the zero-gradient default is the shared root, so the defect can recur anywhere the caller forgets.

TESTS THAT WOULD HAVE CAUGHT IT, and which should exist going forward:
- GLOBAL ENERGY BALANCE: mdot*(h_out - h_in) == lateral/source power + d(stored)/dt, asserted at steady state AND through a transient. Catches every boundary defect of this class, including unknown ones. A per-setter test only catches the one already known about.
- REVERSAL TEST: drive a flow reversal and assert enthalpy stays bounded. A forward-flow-only test passes identically with a wrong outlet BC and proves nothing.

PROCESS NOTE, deliberately recorded: the symptom-level diagnosis passed every check an AI would think to run, because the tests were written against the same flawed mental model as the code. This is the concrete instance behind RESPONSIBLE_USE.md's rule that AI output is untrusted draft material until a human reviews it. Human domain expertise caught it; three rounds of AI briefing did not.
title: Energy-equation BCs were zero-gradient on both sides — audit every fluid array for the same class of defect
